Set up the Windows sandbox

Muse runs the agent's commands in a sandbox. To set it up, Muse needs
administrator permission to create or update two local Windows accounts
and a MuseSandboxUsers group for them:

  muse-sbx-r1  runs commands that have no network access, or that can reach
               the network only through Muse's proxy.
  muse-sbx-u1  runs commands that are allowed to use the network.

Both are standard accounts, not administrators, and separate from your own
account, so commands that run as them can change your files only where Muse
allows, such as your workspace. Muse creates and protects their passwords;
you never sign in to them. Windows may list them on the sign-in screen and
under C:\Users.

If you continue, Windows may ask you to approve this change.

> 1  Yes, set up the sandbox
  2  No, exit

Use Up/Down or 1/2, then Enter. Esc exits.
